rules.title: California Government Code section 12955 (Housing Discrimination; source of income)
rules.requirement: Bars housing discrimination based on source of income, including housing vouchers. Where a government rent subsidy applies, landlords must assess income only against the tenant's portion of the rent and must let applicants offer alternative evidence of ability to pay in place of credit history. Landlords may still ask about the level or source of income.
rules.status_basis: Amended by Stats. 2023, Ch. 776, Sec. 1 (SB 267). Effective January 1, 2024.

coverage.summary: Applies to owners of housing accommodations generally.
